subtasks.claudeMd:
# Build System & Shell Agent

You are adding missing preferences and verifying the Mogwser Firefox fork build infrastructure and browser chrome shell. Most files already exist and are complete — your main task is adding 3 missing prefs.

## CRITICAL: Read Before Writing
Run `git log --oneline -10` first, then read every file you plan to modify before making changes.

## Primary Task: Add Missing Prefs

The file at `prefs/mogwser.yaml` has 31 prefs. Add these 3 in the appropriate sections, following the existing YAML format exactly (key, type, value, description fields):

1. Under the `# Sidebar` section, after `mogwser.sidebar.position`:
```yaml
mogwser.sidebar.collapsed-width:
  type: int
  value: 48
  description: "Sidebar width in compact mode in pixels"
```

2. Under the `# Split View` section, after `mogwser.splitview.max-panels`:
```yaml
mogwser.splitview.handle-size:
  type: int
  value: 6
  description: "Split-view resize handle thickness in pixels"
```

3. Under the `# Tabs` section, after `mogwser.tabs.double-click-new-tab`:
```yaml
mogwser.tabs.show-close-button:
  type: bool
  value: true
  description: "Show close button on tab rows"
```

## Verification Steps

1. After adding prefs, count them: `grep -c '^mogwser\.' prefs/mogwser.yaml` should return 34
2. Verify gluon.json is valid: `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('gluon.json'))"`
3. Verify browser.toml has 8 entries: count `["browser_mogwser_` entries
4. Verify xpcshell.toml has 4 entries: count `["test_` entries
5. Verify sessionstore.patch has `window.dispatchEvent`

## Conventions
- Prefs use YAML format with type, value, description fields
- YAML keys are `mogwser.<module>.<setting>` format
- Follow the exact indentation (2 spaces) and quoting style of existing prefs
- Custom events dispatch on `window`, not `document`

integration.claudeMd:
# Integration Agent

You are merging work from 4 parallel agents into a cohesive Mogwser browser.

## CRITICAL: Read Before Writing
Run `git log --oneline -20` first. Identify all sub-branches. Merge in this order:
1. sub-0 (build system + shell — prefs additions)
2. sub-1 (tabs + workspaces — keyboard shortcut test)
3. sub-2 (advanced UI — min panel size test)
4. sub-3 (themes + privacy — roundtrip, hex, protection level tests)

## Post-Merge Verification Checklist

### Preferences Count
`grep -c '^mogwser\.' prefs/mogwser.yaml` must return 34 or more.

### Event Targets
All custom events MUST dispatch on `window`:
- `patches/sessionstore.patch`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSessionRestored", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/workspaces/MogwserWorkspaces.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserWorkspaceChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/themes/MogwserThemeEngine.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserThemeChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/compact/MogwserCompactMode.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserCompactModeChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/splitview/MogwserSplitView.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSplitViewChanged", ...))`

And all listeners MUST use `window.addEventListener`.

### Storage Integration
- MogwserSplitView._persistGroups must use `MogwserWorkspaceStorage` (imported directly at the top of the file)
- MogwserWorkspaceStorage.save() merges with existing data, preserving `splitGroups` key

### Module Initialization (MogwserShell.mjs)
Verify order: ThemeEngine -> TabBar -> Workspaces -> SplitView -> CompactMode -> SidePanel -> PrivacyPanel

### Test Files
- `tests/browser/browser.toml`: 8 entries
- `tests/unit/xpcshell.toml`: 4 entries
- Verify no syntax errors in test files (proper `add_task` pattern, matching braces)

### Prompt API Pattern
Both `MogwserWorkspaces._promptRename` and `MogwserPrivacyPanel._promptAddException` must use:
```js
const result = { value: ... };
const ok = Services.prompt.prompt(window, title, msg, result, null, {});
if (ok && result.value) { ... }
```

## Conventions
- ES modules (.mjs), static class singletons
- Globals on `window`: gMogwserShell, gMogwserThemeEngine, gMogwserTabBar, gMogwserWorkspaces, gMogwserSplitView, gMogwserCompactMode, gMogwserSidePanel, gMogwserPrivacyPanel
- CSS BEM naming: `.mogwser-shell__sidebar`
- Custom events dispatch on `window`, not `document`
- Prefs: `mogwser.<module>.<setting>` in YAML format
